An '''advanced concussion missile''' was a type of missile used by [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
Compared to standard [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]], advanced concussion missiles had a higher blast rating and exit velocity, and they were capable of tracking a target for a longer period of time. A pair was enough to eliminate a fully-shielded [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] or [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]].<ref name="SW:TF" /> They also carried a green shield around the warheads.<ref name="Draw Their Fire">{{FFGTCG|set=Draw Their Fire|cardname=Advanced Concussion Missiles}}</ref>

==History==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
After the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] discovered technology to upgrade concussion missiles used by the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] to advanced concussion missiles during the [[Mission to Prefsbelt IV|raid]] on the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] on [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]].<ref name="RS II" />

Antilles also discovered the technology during the [[Battle of Dubrillion (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] of [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]].<ref name="RS III">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>
{{Endgame}}

Other Rebel forces used advanced concussion missiles in their craft during the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="SW:XA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

Advanced missiles were equipped on new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] craft such as [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avenger]], TIE Defender, and the [[Missile Boat]] (where its standard armament was two launchers each with 20 advanced missiles). The traitor [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]]'s TIE Avengers were never equipped with advanced missiles, while Stele's loyalist unit of Avengers was, enabling Stele and his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmen]] to defeat waves of Harkov's fighters. During the [[Zaarin insurrection]], as regular missiles proved largely insufficient, [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] and [[Mine Type C]]s also received advanced missiles as well.<ref name="SW:TF" />

Imperial pilot Maarek Stele, when often facing enemy Defenders in a Gunboat or Avenger, however often opted to advanced [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] instead, using his tractor beam weapon to snare the opposing fighter, and one advanced torpedo was enough to take out a full-strength Defender.<ref name="SW:TF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Advanced concussion missiles first appeared in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] as a more powerful missile. They served the same role in the later ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''. In ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]'', concussion missiles may be upgraded to the advanced version if the player picks up the upgrade during ''Imperial Academy Heist'' mission during the daytime version. Acquiring the technology is required for the mission's gold medal, and this article assumes the player did so. The technology may also be acquired in the game's sequel ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'' during the ''Guns of Dubrillion'' mission.
